Behind every reliable network is someone people can count on when it matters. For more than a decade I have been that person for a large, multi-site organisation across East Africa, leading IT service delivery, enterprise network infrastructure, digital workflows and administrative operations so that others can focus on their real work.

As Assistant IT Department and Technical Team Lead, I have guided cross-functional teams through campus-wide single-mode fibre overhauls, high-density Wi-Fi modernisation and greenfield network rollouts in remote, demanding places such as South Sudan.

I bring analytical thinking, careful resource planning and deep respect for confidential information, backed by cloud and cybersecurity posture assessments with DHS CSET. I am eager to bring that dependability to technology-driven, business-focused teams, on-site, remote or hybrid.
